messages:
nina_finance: Incoming invoice from 'TallinnCloud OÜ' for $12,000. They marked VAT 0% and provided VAT ID EE102345678.
martin_sales: hmm, EU B2B typically reverse charge. Did they include our EU VAT on invoice?
nina_finance: no, net amount only. Vendor also asked if we can gross-up for any withholding — they said their accountant requested it.
oleg_ops: Estonia generally no WHT on cross-border services. gross-up shouldn't apply. We need to confirm VAT ID in VIES though.
VIES-bot: Automated VIES lookup: EE102345678 -> status: INVALID / not found :thinking:
raquel_legal: If VIES returns invalid, ask vendor for proof of VAT registration (extract from Estonian Tax Office) or a corrected invoice with local VAT charged (23%).
payments-bot: Payment hold placed on invoice 0xA7 until finance confirms.
nina_finance: asked vendor for Estonian VAT extract and a signed e-invoice. Pitched two options: 1) provide valid VAT ID -> reverse charge net invoice, 2) reissue with 23% VAT and we pay gross.
martin_sales: also requested vendor's business registry code (they provided 14912345?). Could be mismatch.
oleg_ops: can we make a conditional payment? i.e., pay net and require refund if later VAT owed? risky.
raquel_legal: don't self-assess VAT. If they can't provide evidence, we should ask them to reissue with VAT and we process; if they persist on reverse charge without docs, escalate to procurement.
nina_finance: noted. I'm reconciling usage credits against this invoice too, will hold until EOD Fri. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
martin_sales: thanks. ping me if vendor pushes back — I can take call with them. :thumbsup:
